name: Damage Charts (Details meter)
author: zaxnyd; Details-style fork by Joseph
description: Details!-style damage meter for STS2: Damage Done, DPS per turn, Damage Taken, a dedicated Doom & Poison section, and live enemy debuffs. Hover a bar for a breakdown; whole-run numbers between fights. Hotkey C opens the full breakdown. Cosmetic only, multiplayer safe.
